5.2.rationale: None of the candidate sentences mention education/awareness activities about gender equality, women’s rights, non-discrimination, or gender norms, nor do they link any such activities to preventing violence against women. The only education/training referenced concerns handling domestic violence cases and publicity of the Act, not gender equality education.

5.4.indicator: Prevention through education and improving the quality of education
5.4.rationale: Although the Act defines “school” and includes training programmes for police/judicial officers, none of the candidate sentences identify education institutions, curricula, or improvements in education quality as measures to prevent violence against women. The education/training provisions are professional capacity-building for handling domestic violence cases, not school/curriculum-based prevention.

5.5.rationale: The candidate sentences do not provide any prevention activities specifically engaging men or boys (e.g., programmes targeting men/boys, positive masculinity, or gender-norm change).
